hasDefinedTerm.name: ADR
hasDefinedTerm.description: Average daily rate. Room revenue divided by rooms sold.

hasDefinedTerm.name: RevPAR
hasDefinedTerm.description: Revenue per available room. Occupancy multiplied by average daily rate.

hasDefinedTerm.name: occupancy rate
hasDefinedTerm.description: The share of available rooms sold in a period.

hasDefinedTerm.name: TRevPAR
hasDefinedTerm.description: Total revenue per available room, including food, beverage, and other spend.

hasDefinedTerm.name: GOPPAR
hasDefinedTerm.description: Gross operating profit per available room. A profitability rather than revenue measure.

ctx.expansion: Gross operating profit per available room

hasDefinedTerm.name: length of stay
hasDefinedTerm.description: Average nights per booking. Longer stays lower servicing cost per night.

hasDefinedTerm.name: booking window
hasDefinedTerm.description: How far ahead of arrival a reservation is made.

hasDefinedTerm.name: OTA
hasDefinedTerm.description: Online travel agency. A third-party booking channel charging commission per reservation.

hasDefinedTerm.name: direct booking
hasDefinedTerm.description: A reservation made through the property's own channels, avoiding commission.

hasDefinedTerm.name: rate parity
hasDefinedTerm.description: Keeping published rates consistent across distribution channels.

hasDefinedTerm.name: channel manager
hasDefinedTerm.description: Software syncing availability and rates across booking channels.

hasDefinedTerm.name: PMS
hasDefinedTerm.description: Property management system. The operational system of record for reservations and rooms.

hasDefinedTerm.name: CRS
hasDefinedTerm.description: Central reservation system. The hub distributing inventory to booking channels.

hasDefinedTerm.name: GDS
hasDefinedTerm.description: Global distribution system. The legacy network travel agents use to book inventory.

hasDefinedTerm.name: yield management
hasDefinedTerm.description: Adjusting price and availability by demand to maximise revenue rather than occupancy.

hasDefinedTerm.name: overbooking
hasDefinedTerm.description: Deliberately accepting more reservations than rooms, priced against expected cancellations.

hasDefinedTerm.name: no-show
hasDefinedTerm.description: A confirmed guest who never arrives.

hasDefinedTerm.name: walk
hasDefinedTerm.description: Relocating a guest to another property when the hotel is oversold.

hasDefinedTerm.name: comp set
hasDefinedTerm.description: The group of properties a hotel benchmarks its performance against.

hasDefinedTerm.name: STR report
hasDefinedTerm.description: A benchmarking report comparing a property's performance against its comp set.

hasDefinedTerm.name: shoulder season
hasDefinedTerm.description: The period between peak and low season, with softer rates and demand.

hasDefinedTerm.name: group business
hasDefinedTerm.description: Bookings from conferences, weddings, and corporate blocks.

hasDefinedTerm.name: MICE
hasDefinedTerm.description: Meetings, incentives, conferences, and exhibitions. The organized-events segment.

hasDefinedTerm.name: F&B
hasDefinedTerm.description: Food and beverage. Usually the second-largest revenue line after rooms.

hasDefinedTerm.name: cover
hasDefinedTerm.description: One meal served to one guest. The unit of restaurant volume.

hasDefinedTerm.name: RevPASH
hasDefinedTerm.description: Revenue per available seat hour. The restaurant analogue of RevPAR.

hasDefinedTerm.name: front of house
hasDefinedTerm.description: The guest-facing part of an operation.

hasDefinedTerm.name: back of house
hasDefinedTerm.description: The operational areas guests do not see.

hasDefinedTerm.name: turndown
hasDefinedTerm.description: Evening room service preparing the room for the night.

hasDefinedTerm.name: upsell
hasDefinedTerm.description: Offering a higher-value option at or after booking.

hasDefinedTerm.name: ancillary revenue
hasDefinedTerm.description: Income beyond the core product, such as parking, spa, or late checkout.

hasDefinedTerm.name: loyalty program
hasDefinedTerm.description: A structured incentive rewarding repeat stays, and a major direct-booking driver.

hasDefinedTerm.name: guest satisfaction score
hasDefinedTerm.description: A survey-based measure of guest experience.

hasDefinedTerm.name: review response rate
hasDefinedTerm.description: The share of guest reviews the property replies to. A visible trust signal.

hasDefinedTerm.name: destination content
hasDefinedTerm.description: Editorial about the surrounding area. Captures planning-stage intent before a property is chosen.

hasDefinedTerm.name: seasonality
hasDefinedTerm.description: Predictable demand swings across the year. The central planning constraint in travel.

hasDefinedTerm.name: cancellation policy
hasDefinedTerm.description: The terms under which a booking may be voided and what is refunded.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Hotel schema
hasDefinedTerm.description: Structured data describing a property's rooms, amenities, and rates for enriched search results.
